name: sfx_platform
description: ScaleFX platform foundation — cross-platform abstraction (mutexes, delays, GPIO, servo, timers), stateless wire encoding (CRC-8, COBS, endian helpers), and DiagLog diagnostic logging. Zero external library dependencies. Supports RP2040/RP2350 (Pico SDK) and ESP32-S3 (ESP-IDF/FreeRTOS).
